post.caption:
You unlocked your phone 96 times today. Allah called you 5. 📱

7:12 a.m. on the metro, unlock number 4. 5:04 p.m. on your balcony, unlock number 96 — and from the green dome across the roofs, the adhan. Two calls at once. Only one says “come to success.”

“Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.” (2:186)

This Maghrib, when the adhan starts: phone face down. Go.

captions: Tuesday. 7:12 a.m., the metro. Unlock number 4.
Nobody looks up. You don’t either.
A notification. Then another. Then forty.
Fajr? You heard the alarm. You swiped it away.
Then, from the green dome across the roofs: the adhan.
“Allahu akbar.” Your phone buzzes at the same time.
Two calls at once. Only one says “come to success.”
You turn the phone face down.
Cold water on your hands. The screen stays dark.
Three rak’ahs of Maghrib. Nothing to scroll past.
Unlock 97 can wait. He answered first.
